inquiry: Does the existing golang.org/x/sys dependency provide a caller-owned Darwin directory reader without hidden DIR allocation or ignored close outcomes?
trace: Darwin Getdirentries emulates through Openat(fd,"."), fdopendir, readdir_r, and deferred closedir.
fdopendir failure calls Close(fd2) without propagating its result; deferred closedir(d) ignores its result.
The wrapper explicitly disclaims directories edited underfoot and retains entry-count seek emulation.
conclusion: Using this existing dependency does not eliminate the hidden DIR allocation/admission/cleanup-outcome gap. The original Darwin blocker remains; Linux direct Getdents caller-buffer implementation must not be generalized to Darwin by changing import only.
next_action: Provide a supported original same-algorithm bounded/custodied Darwin reader with actual close outcomes and native validation. No raw unsupported syscall or path-based fallback was accepted.
